content.rationale: Creating the directories is where the invocation meets the state directory and the node layout; the gate keeps it answerable to both without re-deciding either. Its two edges span two cells — one prose parent (natural→structured) and one requirement-sentence parent (structured→structured) — so the criterion is the default cell's gate form; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up).
